scope: Explicit review of six previously open editorial issues. This closes only the stated summary scope, not individual applications, interactive records or external service availability.

resolutions.decision: Official register description verified. Exact programme records still require a separate check.
IND page updated 21 September 2026 confirms the recognised sponsor, full-time accredited programme and institution-led application.
The Department of Education confirms that providers enrolling overseas students on student visas must be ESOS registered and CRICOS listed. Individual entries are outside this review.
Selected Article 91 document categories verified in the official page returned by web search. Direct page retrieval still returned 502; automatic access is not certified.
The ministry identifies RUCT and SIIU as QEDU inputs and states that the information is orientative. Interactive course records were not audited.
The current federal portal route confirms EUR 11,904 in 2026 for the study route, with scholarship and declaration-of-commitment alternatives. Study-place seeking is a different route.

notices.title: Spain: university electronic service suspension
notices.summary: The ministry’s notice of 22 October 2026 announces a temporary closure of the university electronic office and suspension of affected procedures, including foreign-degree recognition. Consult the official notice before submitting an application; resumption has not been confirmed in this review.
